prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV (sunbed) tanning or spray/airbrush (sunless) tanning — and what part of Columbus are you in or nearest zip code? I can give a personalized list of top-rated salons once I know that.

Quick guidance while you decide:
- If you want sunless/spray tanning, look for salons that use reputable brands (Norvell, VersaSpa) and certified technicians who do a patch test and match a shade to your skin tone. Ask to see before/after photos.
- If you want UV tanning, prioritize salons with modern, well‑maintained beds, clear staff guidance on exposure time, and good ventilation. Note health risks of UV tanning and follow safety limits.
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews and check photos, cleanliness, pricing, and whether they honor reservations/walk-ins.
- Ask about packages, memberships, and first‑time discounts; for spray tans, ask about pre‑ and post‑care (exfoliation, avoiding lotions/oils).

Tell me spray vs UV and your area and I’ll find the best current options and contact details.
